reason: A cross-platform desktop container for DeepSeek Harness that launches and manages its local web UI, provides logs and configuration, and optionally enables paired browser control over the local network.

summaries.zh: 一款面向 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面容器，负责启动和管理本地 Web UI，并提供日志、配置及局域网手机控制功能。
summaries.en: A cross-platform desktop container for DeepSeek Harness that launches and manages its local web UI with logging, configuration, and optional paired phone control over the local network.

capabilities: Launches a local DeepSeek Harness web UI through npm, pnpm, Node.js, and a child process tree
Manages and terminates local application processes
Downloads and runs a fixed version of an npm package
Provides optional same-LAN browser control through a local HTTPS proxy and device pairing
Writes application logs and manages local workspace and profile configuration
Installs and tracks four bundled DeepSeek Harness plugins
